payload.title: Capture: show when a Reference's text was cut (400 KB HTML guard) in references show and the console
payload.description: Router capture (reference_capture.py via link_exploration.fetch, MAXIMUM_BYTES=400_000 in ideas/excerpt.py) cuts HTML at 400 KB and still stores the result as a completed capture; only signals.responseTruncated and the 'was cut' completeness flag record it. Measured on MoM: 8 of 37 completed pending captures had responseTruncated (e.g. a Tom's Hardware page captured as 65 characters, a Yahoo article cut mid-sentence), and each was summarized. A 306,000-character 10-K would be cut well before its financial notes. Show 'truncated' and total characters in references show and the console card as a first-class field (not only a thin flag); consider following with a ranged or full read for filings (HTML limit by text, not by bytes of markup). PDFs: 8 MB guard fails as too_large (no partial text). Summary window keeps head 100k + tail 20k chars (inputTruncated on the card). Related: papyrus references text (PR feat/references-text).
